page-canvas.$description: Page Canvas — Page background, full-bleed canvas behind all product imagery and content bands

deep-surface.$description: Deep Surface — Dark supporting neutral for text, icons, and strong contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

void.$description: Void — Deepest layer — button cores, icon fills, the negative space inside navigation controls

platinum.$description: Platinum — Primary text, icons, link body, badges, footer text — the only light-on-dark workhorse

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Selected link states, rare icon contrast points on dark surfaces

iron.$description: Iron — Input field surface — one subtle step above canvas for form wells

ash.$description: Ash — Input placeholder and helper text — low-contrast gray on the dark input field

neue-haas-grotesk-text-pro.$description: Body, navigation, labels, product names, mid-size headings — the workhorse text face used in 95% of the UI

neue-haas-grotesk-display-pro.$description: Display headlines and section titles — 64px for hero statements, 31px for section headings, 24px for emphasized links/labels; the 450 weight is the headline sweet spot between Helvetica Regular and Medium

digi-one-v2.$description: Decorative dot-matrix accent — echoes the LCD readouts on Elektron hardware, used for tag labels and technical micro-copy; do not over-deploy, it's a signature flourish, not a workhorse

nhaasgroteskdspro.$description: Button and input labels — same family as the display face, used for control text only

analog-one-v2.$description: Analog One V2. — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
